title: Parliament debates and votes on motion on Pritam Singh's conduct and suitability as Leader of the Opposition
what_it_is: A motion moved by the Leader of the House asking Parliament to affirm honesty and integrity, note court and Committee of Privileges findings, express regret at Mr Pritam Singh's conduct, consider him unsuitable to continue as Leader of the Opposition, note implications for Ms Sylvia Lim and Mr Faisal Manap, and call on MPs to uphold the law.
why_it_matters: The transcript states the Motion does not impose penalties or sanctions on Mr Pritam Singh under the PPIPA and does not itself remove the Leader of the Opposition; that designation is for the Prime Minister to decide. The House voted, the Ayes had it, and dissent was recorded for named Members. The Motion also asks the House to note that the High Court judgment and COP findings have implications for Ms Sylvia Lim and Mr Faisal Manap, to be considered separately.

key_points.point: The Leader of the House moved the Motion standing in her name.
key_points.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
key_points.quote: I wish to move the Motion standing in my name in today's Order Paper.

key_points.point: The Motion's first limb affirms honesty and integrity as fundamental pillars.
key_points.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
key_points.quote: Affirm that honesty and integrity are fundamental pillars of Singapore's parliamentary and political system

key_points.point: The Leader said the House is not being asked to impose penalties or sanctions on Mr Pritam Singh under the PPIPA.
key_points.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
key_points.quote: the House is not being asked to impose any penalties or sanctions on Mr Pritam Singh under the PPIPA.

key_points.point: The Leader said the fourth limb does not remove the Leader of the Opposition; the Prime Minister decides whether Mr Singh continues.
key_points.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
key_points.quote: The Leader of the Opposition is designated by the Prime Minister and the decision whether Mr Singh should continue with that designation rests with the Prime Minister, not Parliament.

key_points.point: The Leader said the fifth limb proposes that matters concerning Ms Lim and Mr Faisal be considered separately on another occasion.
key_points.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
key_points.quote: the fifth limb proposes that their matters be considered separately on another occasion.

key_points.point: The Leader said the High Court upheld Mr Singh's conviction on two counts of lying before the COP.
key_points.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
key_points.quote: the High Court upheld Mr Pritam Singh's conviction by the District Court on two counts of lying before the COP.

key_points.point: The Leader said Mr Singh told Ms Khan to take the Untruth to the grave.
key_points.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
key_points.quote: Mr Singh told Ms Khan to take the Untruth to the grave.

key_points.point: The Leader said the District Court found Mr Singh guided Ms Khan to continue her Untruth in Parliament.
key_points.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
key_points.quote: Mr Singh guided Ms Khan to continue her Untruth in Parliament.

key_points.point: The Leader said Mr Singh lied twice before the COP.
key_points.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
key_points.quote: he then lied twice before the COP

key_points.point: The Leader said Mr Singh has stated he accepts the High Court's judgment fully and without reservation.
key_points.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
key_points.quote: Mr Singh has stated that he accepts the High Court's judgment "fully and without reservation".

key_points.point: Mr Pritam Singh said the party whip is lifted for WP MPs.
key_points.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
key_points.quote: the party whip is lifted.

key_points.point: Mr Pritam Singh said he accepts the verdict fully and without reservation but disagrees with it.
key_points.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
key_points.quote: I will explain why I was disappointed with the judgment and therefore do not agree with it.

key_points.point: Mr Pritam Singh said he rejects Resolution 2.
key_points.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
key_points.quote: I reject Resolution 2.

key_points.point: Mr Pritam Singh said he rejects Resolution 3.
key_points.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
key_points.quote: so I reject Resolution 3 of the Motion.

key_points.point: Mr Pritam Singh said he rejects Resolution 4.
key_points.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
key_points.quote: I reject Resolution 4, which flows from Resolutions 2 and 3.

key_points.point: Mr Pritam Singh said no action should be taken against Ms Sylvia Lim and Mr Faisal Manap.
key_points.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
key_points.quote: I take the view that no action should be taken against my colleagues, Sylvia Lim and Faisal Manap

key_points.point: Mr Pritam Singh said Resolution 6 is unobjectionable.
key_points.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
key_points.quote: that makes Resolution 6 of the Motion unobjectionable.

key_points.point: Mr Pritam Singh said he takes full responsibility for not responding quickly enough to correct Ms Khan's lie.
key_points.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
key_points.quote: I take full responsibility for not responding quickly enough to correct Khan's lie

key_points.point: Mr Pritam Singh said he did not expect the MP to double down on her lie.
key_points.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
key_points.quote: I certainly did not expect the MP to double down on her lie when asked about it

key_points.point: Mr Pritam Singh said he disagrees with the finding of guilt by the Courts and the COP.
key_points.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
key_points.quote: I disagree with the finding of guilt by the Courts and the COP.

key_points.point: Mr Pritam Singh said he asked the PP for permission to use undisclosed statements and the request was rejected.
key_points.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
key_points.quote: my request was rejected by the PP.

key_points.point: Mr Pritam Singh said Parliament is sovereign.
key_points.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
key_points.quote: Parliament is sovereign, which means it is supreme above all other Government institutions

key_points.point: Mr Pritam Singh said he will continue his work as an MP in Aljunied GRC.
key_points.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
key_points.quote: as long as I am an MP, I will continue my work as a MP on the ground in Aljunied GRC

key_points.point: Ms Kuah Boon Theng said she otherwise supports the Motion.
key_points.speaker: Ms Kuah Boon Theng (Nominated Member)
key_points.quote: I otherwise support the Motion.

key_points.point: Ms Kuah Boon Theng invited Mr Pritam Singh to reflect and voluntarily give up the position of Leader of the Opposition.
key_points.speaker: Ms Kuah Boon Theng (Nominated Member)
key_points.quote: I invite Mr Pritam Singh to reflect on his own conduct and indicate if he would be the first to agree that he has, indeed, fallen below the standards that should rightly be expected of him

key_points.point: Ms Tin Pei Ling said Parliament must uphold and demonstrate honesty, integrity and accountability.
key_points.speaker: Ms Tin Pei Ling (Marine Parade-Braddell Heights)
key_points.quote: our Parliament must uphold and demonstrate the principles of honesty, integrity, and accountability

key_points.point: Ms Tin Pei Ling said when the first lie is discovered, it must be stopped to prevent a second or third.
key_points.speaker: Ms Tin Pei Ling (Marine Parade-Braddell Heights)
key_points.quote: when the first lie is discovered, it must be stopped to prevent a second or even a third from occurring.

key_points.point: Mr Low Wu Yang Andre said he agrees with limbs one and six and does not agree with limbs two to five.
key_points.speaker: Mr Low Wu Yang Andre (Non-Constituency Member)
key_points.quote: I agree with limbs one and six of the Motion; and I do not agree with limbs two to five.

key_points.point: The Leader said Parliament cannot wait on the WP nor should its view depend on the WP's internal deliberations.
key_points.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
key_points.quote: Parliament cannot wait on the WP nor should our view depend on the WP's internal deliberations

key_points.point: The Leader said the Leader of the Opposition is not an ordinary MP.
key_points.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
key_points.quote: The Leader of the Opposition is not an ordinary MP.

key_points.point: The Leader said if Members agree, they should vote in favour of the Motion.
key_points.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
key_points.quote: If Members agree with this conclusion, they should vote in favour of the Motion.

key_points.point: The Leader said the WP's response contrasts with its swift actions in the cases of Ms Khan and Mr Perera.
key_points.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
key_points.quote: It is strange that the WP could act so decisively in the cases of Ms Khan and Mr Perera

key_points.point: The Leader said the Motion only notes that the Court judgment and COP findings have implications for Ms Lim and Mr Faisal.
key_points.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
key_points.quote: That is all that this Motion does: to note that it has implications.

key_points.point: The Leader said the House will come back to the matters concerning Ms Lim and Mr Faisal and will not take too long.
key_points.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
key_points.quote: We will come back. We will not take too long.

key_points.point: Ms Sylvia Lim asked what the Leader's remarks had to do with the resolutions.
key_points.speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim (Aljunied)
key_points.quote: I wonder, what the Leader has been saying, what has it got to do with the resolutions?

key_points.point: Mr Kenneth Tiong Boon Kiat raised a Point of Order that characterisations imputed improper motives beyond the Court's findings.
key_points.speaker: Mr Kenneth Tiong Boon Kiat (Aljunied)
key_points.quote: These characterisations impute improper motives beyond the Court's actual findings.

key_points.point: The Leader responded that if the Court rejects a statement as untrue, it follows as a matter of logic that what was told to the Court is not the truth.
key_points.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
key_points.quote: If a statement is made to the Court and the Court finds that that is not true or rejects it, it must follow, as a matter of logic, that what was told to the Court, is not the truth.

key_points.point: The Leader said 'Conceal' usually means cover-up.
key_points.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
key_points.quote: “Conceal”, if one looks in the general meaning of the dictionary usually means cover-up.

key_points.point: Mr K Shanmugam said it appeared that a legislative provision sets out the framework for releasing such information.
key_points.speaker: The Coordinating Minister for National Security and Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
key_points.quote: it would appear that it is set out in a legislative provision that such information can only be released within the framework set out in that legislation.

key_points.point: The Speaker said he would study the request and make a ruling at a later stage.
key_points.speaker: Mr Speaker
key_points.quote: I will study this further and I will make a ruling on your request at a later stage.

key_points.point: The Speaker said the Ayes had it.
key_points.speaker: Mr Speaker
key_points.quote: I think the "Ayes" have it, the "Ayes" have it.

key_points.point: The Speaker said dissent would be recorded.
key_points.speaker: Mr Speaker
key_points.quote: We will have it recorded.

key_points.point: Ms Sylvia Lim said the WP has processes and they will take their course.
key_points.speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim (Aljunied)
key_points.quote: we have our processes and the processes will take their course.

key_points.point: Ms Sylvia Lim said she maintains that the Court findings cannot be held against her.
key_points.speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim (Aljunied)
key_points.quote: I am still going to maintain that those findings cannot be held against me

key_points.point: The Leader said Ms Lim and Mr Faisal gave evidence before the COP under oath.
key_points.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
key_points.quote: Ms Lim and Mr Faisal did appear and give evidence before the COP, and they gave evidence under oath.

key_points.point: The Leader said the COP found Ms Lim and Mr Faisal had lied about what happened at the meeting.
key_points.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
key_points.quote: the COP found that Ms Lim and Mr Faisal had lied about what had happened there.

key_points.point: Mr Pritam Singh said he fully accepts the authority and finality of the Court's decision but disagrees with the findings.
key_points.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
key_points.quote: I fully accept the authority and the finality of the Court's decision. I disagree with the findings.

key_points.point: Mr Pritam Singh said a judgment determines legal responsibility but does not require a person to abandon their honest belief.
key_points.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
key_points.quote: A judgment determines legal responsibility. It does not require a person to abandon their honest belief about their motivations and their values.

key_points.point: Mr Pritam Singh said he has not disappeared and avoided scrutiny.
key_points.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
key_points.quote: I have not disappeared and avoided scrutiny.

key_points.point: Mr Pritam Singh said the WP will continue serving in the role.
key_points.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
key_points.quote: the WP will continue serving in this role.

what_happens_next: The House voted; the Ayes had it and dissent was recorded for named Members. The Speaker said he will study Mr Singh's request to read out a Police statement and make a ruling at a later stage. The Leader said the matters concerning Ms Lim and Mr Faisal will be considered separately and "We will come back. We will not take too long."

What will the Workers' Party's disciplinary panel conclude, and when will the Special Cadre Members' Conference be convened?
What specific action, if any, will Parliament take on the matters concerning Ms Sylvia Lim and Mr Faisal Manap, and when?
